The '''Rryatt Ceremonial Guard''' was a ceremonial [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] guard that guarded the giant gate to the [[Rryatt Trail]], a long and dangerous trail that eventually led its travelers to the [[Shadowlands/Legends|shadowy surface]] of Kashyyyk.

[[File:Rryatt_captain_of_the_guard.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Captain of the Guard.]]
They were led by the [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]].
